$description: Spacing, radii, sizes and border widths.

space.$description: 4-based scale. Matches the M3 4dp grid and the iOS 8pt rhythm.

gutter.$description: Screen side margin on phones (iOS layout margin, M3 compact margin).

gutter-wide.$description: Side margin at ≥ 600px (M3 medium window class).

radius.$description: Mirrors the M3 shape scale. iOS applies the same values with .continuous corners.

md.$description: Cards, list groups (iOS inset grouped list ~10–12).

lg.$description: Prominent cards (next-up session), large buttons in the logger.

full.$description: Pills: M3 buttons, status chips, avatars.

touch-min.$description: Minimum hit target. Satisfies M3 (48dp) and iOS HIG (44pt).

touch-large.$description: Logger steppers and 'save set': one hand, sweaty thumbs, glanced at between sets.

content-max.$description: Max width of public booking content on large screens.

control.$description: Visible control height (buttons, inputs, list rows). The hit target never drops below touch-min on touch, or 24px (WCAG 2.2 target size) with a mouse.

ios.$description: iOS HIG minimum; buttons and rows in the iOS app.

compact.$description: Trainer Web with a mouse or trackpad.

compact-sm.$description: Toolbars and segmented controls in Trainer Web.
